target_customer: Retail traders on prediction markets and other exchanges
problem: Turning a trading idea into a backtested, continuously running strategy requires data, quant skills and execution infrastructure that retail traders lack.
business_model: Trading platform, likely fees or volume based (not stated)

founders.name: Shirley (Shiyi) Peng
previous_startups: MasterInterview (top 10 GPT in OpenAI GPT Store, per YC page)

founders.name: Jerry Miao
founders.background_notes: YC page: six years as a solo quant. Founders say they bootstrapped multiple apps to $500K ARR together.

competitors.name: Public
competitors.what: Brokerage with AI agents and Kalshi prediction markets integration

technical_complexity.rationale: Backtesting, data feeds and multi-exchange live execution are real engineering, mostly on existing APIs.

defensibility.rationale: Exchange partnerships and user trading history help, but the idea is easy to copy by brokers and exchanges.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Public announced Kalshi agent integrations in September 2026; Kalshi partnership claims for AnyAlpha come from YC page only.

market_need_then: Prediction market volumes grew sharply in 2025 to 2026 and agent trading was described as emerging. AnyAlpha reports 1,000+ active traders and over $1M weekly volume (company claim via YC page).

identity.voice_and_tone: Short, confident, imperative taglines such as Your thesis. Your AI trading agent.

brand_strength.rationale: Alpha is trading vocabulary and signals the product at once, but no external brand coverage was found. Dealroom lists a conflicting product name, BetAlpha.

outcome_analysis: AnyAlpha is a Fall 2026 company with no outcome yet. It launched trading in October 2026 on a hot category, prediction markets, with a small repeat-builder team. The main risk is that exchanges and brokers such as Public and Kalshi ship their own agent tools.
notes: Dealroom lists a $125K seed with no investors or date; aggregator only, unverified, not recorded as a round. The Kalshi partnership is claimed on the YC page; a search found no independent confirmation and found a different Public and Kalshi tie-up.
